newsitem.title: USA: Comstock, Marathon find Nueces Cty oil.
newsitem.headline: Comstock, Marathon find Nueces Cty oil.

text.p: Comstock Resources Inc said on Monday that the State Tract 707 No. 1 exploration well in the East White Point field in Nueces County, Texas, was drilled to a depth of 8,085 and encountered a total of 39 feet of net pay in two productive zones.

The well has been completed in the Brigham Sand through perforations 7,361 feet through 7,366 feet and has initially tested 162 barrels of oil, 77,000 cubic feet of natural gas and zero barrels of water per day on 10/64 inch choke with a flowing tubing pressure of 660 pounds per square inch.
In addition to the Brigham Sand, the Catahoula Sand has about 23 feet of net gas pay.
Based on preliminary engineering, Comstock said, the newly discovered Brigham Sand structure could have some 625,000 barrels of oil, net to the company's 30 percent interest.
The operator, Marathon Oil Co, has a 63.25 percent interest, spokesman Bill Ryder said.
Comstock said the two companies are discussing plans to drill a second well in the first quarter of 1997 to determine the productive limits of the reservoir.
